prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: one polished 16:9 landscape raster game UI concept, 遊戲設定 settings screen for 虛擬台麻館.
Input images: image 1 host-game-anime90.png is the principal visual system reference for gold borders, deep jade panels, typography and warm Taiwanese mahjong parlor atmosphere. Image 2 title-virtual-taiwan-mahjong-parlor.png is the title branding and environment reference. Image 3 lanjie/normal.png is the precise Lanjie character identity reference. These are references for a NEW screen, do not copy their layout or menus.
Style: authentic handpainted 1990s Japanese cel anime with confident ink outlines, subtle painted textures, elegant warmnight Taiwanese mahjong parlor. Dark jade, burgundy and antique gold; cream readable Traditional Chinese typography. No modern dashboard, no photorealism, no 3D.
Composition: 16:9 fullscreen game screen, carefully aligned functional settings form occupies roughly left two thirds. A compact single-line game logo 虛擬台麻館 with exactly 'Virtual Taiwan Mahjong Parlor' below sits in the upper left; do not repeat a huge title. Upper right or upper left edge has a restrained back control reading '返回標題'. The main page heading is '遊戲設定'. Two clean sections only, with spacious readable controls and restrained gold borders.
Section one headed '畫面風格': three evenly sized landscape preview cards side by side, labeled exactly '90年代', 'PC-98', 'MS-DOS'. Preview the SAME mahjong parlor imagery in three styles: first lush painted cel anime, second limited-palette detailed retro PC-98 pixelart, third coarse DOS pixelart. The 90年代 card is visibly selected with bright gold border and a small checkmark; other cards unselected.
Section two headed '聲音設定': a row '音樂音量' with a gold horizontal slider at 50% and exact numeric value '50%'; a second row '音效音量' slider at 70% and exact value '70%'; a third row '靜音' with an unmistakably OFF toggle, thumb on left and muted dark track. No additional settings.
At bottom of form show exact small note '設定會自動儲存。' and one burgundy-and-gold completion button labeled '完成'.
Right third is a tasteful modest illustration of Lanjie, the elegant adult woman from image 3 with purple updo, thin gold glasses, red qipao with gold piping, small warm smile. Keep her smaller than the form, waist-up or seated, no controls obscured. Near her is a vintage wooden radio and a blue-and-white porcelain tea service on a dark wood side table. Amber hanging lamp, wooden wall, night window and low-key plants echo reference mood. The radio may subtly relate to the volume section visually but never overlap the UI.
Constraints: all displayed interface Chinese must be Traditional Chinese and must exactly match the strings specified. Readability, generous spacing and control hierarchy are paramount. Only named settings, no resolution/language/account/payment/rules/keybinds/extra tabs. No dialogue bubble, no enormous repeated game title, no extra text, no watermark. Present a finished illustration mockup only.
